description: This source file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV app, implementing the main homepage UI including a hero carousel, continue watching rail, TV channels rail, and integrated top navigation bar using Jetpack Compose. It manages focus navigation, auto-scrolling, layout configurations, and data binding with ViewModel and repositories.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main UI fragment for the Android TV app home screen, managing layout, focus navigation, auto-scrolling, and data binding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes ViewModel and repository.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Sets up the root view hierarchy, including hero banner, rails, and top navigation.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Handles focus requests and subscribes to ViewModel state updates.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes auto-scroll and restores focus when returning to fragment.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses auto-scroll and cancels animations.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Sets up LiveData observers to update UI on data changes.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays error message with retry option.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the Continue Watching rail with fetched data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV Channels rail with fetched data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds a Jetpack Compose top navigation bar to the layout.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Initializes and configures the hero carousel with auto-scrolling and focus management.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers the hero carousel on a specific card index with optional animation.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Pauses auto-scrolling temporarily during user interactions.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Starts the auto-scrolling runnable.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops the auto-scrolling runnable.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Builds the Continue Watching horizontal rail.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Builds the TV Channels horizontal rail.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focusability for the rails, gating user navigation.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to actual pixels.
